title: How luck works
summary: Every luck bonus is added: multiplier = 1 + min(5, sum of the bonuses), so ×6 at most. It boosts chance-based drops and the best grades of the guardian spoils.

blocks.text: Every luck bonus is added up: multiplier = 1 + min(5, sum of the bonuses) (Lucky pass +0.5, a x2 boost +1, guild perk +0.05 a level...), so x6 at most.

blocks.text: Chance-based drops : the elite item (8%), the items of chests, any drop with a chance. Chance × multiplier, 100% at most. Guardian spoils : only the equipment grades above the centre rank are multiplied, by min(multiplier × stars bonus, 3), then the weights are renormalised. Dungeon stars add ×1.1, ×1.25 or ×1.4 for 1, 2 or 3 stars. The daily weapon of the group follows the same rule. The XP and shard multipliers use the same addition rule.
blocks.html:
• Chance-based drops: the elite item (8%), the items of chests, any drop with a chance. Chance × multiplier, 100% at most.
  • Guardian spoils: only the equipment grades above the centre rank are multiplied, by min(multiplier × stars bonus, 3), then the weights are renormalised. Dungeon stars add ×1.1, ×1.25 or ×1.4 for 1, 2 or 3 stars. The daily weapon of the group follows the same rule.
  • The XP and shard multipliers use the same addition rule.
